title: 兩人都哭了 我也想哭了 GTA對咪口來說是有特殊意義的 所以她才那麽想玩這個遊戲 但除了人數不足這個硬傷 這個企劃幕前幕後的各種極為複雜的準備工作 其中所需要動用的公司的資源 以及…
context:
兩人都哭了
我也想哭了
GTA對咪口來說是有特殊意義的
所以她才那麽想玩這個遊戲
但除了人數不足這個硬傷
這個企劃幕前幕後的各種極為複雜的準備工作
其中所需要動用的公司的資源
以及讓許多Holomem 一起從零開始來學習的機會成本
咪口身上背負的壓力之大可想而知
在節目進行過程中也並非一帆風順
好在有Hololive 的大家支援
讓企劃有個圓滿的結局    箱遊成功
而且做出了真的是只有Hololive特有的GTA

雖然這不是咪口第一次辦箱遊
但這次跟以往幾次最不同的事就是彗醬的加入
這次的主催是兩個人  是miComet
這企劃一開始是咪口想做的沒錯
由於咪口的強烈責任感的個性
企劃進行中咪口也一直親力親為
把許多事情攬在自己身上
但彗醬也說咪口都不懂得分配工作
這種大型箱遊肯定是要學會依靠別人的
於是彗醬搶走許多工作去做
分配了咪口的許多壓力
還有在遊戲進行中未達預期效果而出現樂子人時
出來坦了不少炮火
各種以往你想不到星街彗星會做的事情
在咪口的這個企劃中也做了
其實我印象中彗醬對組織大型活動不是那麼有興趣的
而且不要忘了這兩人很快還有Sololive
還有說會減少直播次數後但之後有多少直播是為了咪口而開的
當然企劃的成功每個參與者都有貢獻
不過最接近咪口
最能理解她的心情
也最能成為她心靈支柱的人
就是彗醬
所有的種種
這是真愛

They were crying
So was I
GTA has a special meaning to Miko
Which is why she really wanted to play it
But there was a problem with the amount of people
Plus the complexity of the game for all the preparations required behind the scenes
All the resources tolled on the company
Finally, the opportunity cost from Holomems because they need to be trained from zero
All that pressure on Miko
The road was a bit bumpy for the stream
They’ve hit some obstacles
It was everyone’s effort from Hololive that kept the steering wheel straight and was able to achieve the goal
Also they have successfully created a GTA vibe that’s only possible to get recreated with Hololive talents

This isn’t the first time Miko organized a group gaming event
But it’s this time with Suichan, made a difference
The event organizer is miComet, a group of two people
It’s true that it all started with Miko
Due to Miko’s personality
She felt she should be accountable for everything
But it’s impossible for one person to do everything in a huge project like this
Suichan has also mentioned Mikochi doesn’t know how to distribute works to teammates
So Suichan has to takeaway many work from Miko from she got working too hard and it does help Miko released many of her burdens
Also when the game wasn’t moving forward as expected Suichan bore all the scolding from the trolls
Things you don’t expect Suichan would agree to do she did for Miko
From what I remembered to organize a large project like this isn’t something Suichan was interested in
Furthermore don’t forget that they are both having their Sololives soon
And Suichan has already said that she would reduce the amount of streams in the future, but look at all the streams she held that was related to Miko after she said that
There is no doubt that everyone was involved in this project contributed their part
But the one that stayed the closest to Miko
Understands her heart the most
And her strongest emotion support
There comes Suichan
Everything they did for each other
It’s true love.
